name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
title: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd - 544526 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 margins compressed to ~7% EBITDA on input-cost and rupee shock with fixed-price orders; FY26 EBITDA margin 12.78% on 3,138 MW sales, while cell capacity (2.4 GW) only starts production in 2H FY27.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization remained healthy at over 84% during the year

capex.quote: for FY27, our capex requirement for this expansion is about 1,700 crores

triggers.label: Q4 margins compressed, ~7% EBITDA
triggers.quote: the margins are obviously getting compressed because of the war situation

triggers.label: Cell capacity 6 GW by mid-2027
triggers.quote: we'll be 6 gigawatt by somewhere around mid of -- around July -- yes, June-July 2027

triggers.label: Creditor days cut, recovery in Apr-May
triggers.quote: our creditor days were basically normalized during the year because of these situations

triggers.label: FY27 margin 'healthy' but no number
triggers.quote: Difficult to give a number, but yes, we feel that it will return to a healthy number that existed

triggers.label: Order book 5.89 GW, ~INR8,000 cr
triggers.quote: order book pipeline is 5.89 gigawatt, which is about INR8,000 crores

guidance.quote: overall '27 we see that margins are going to be stable and good

guidance.value: 2.4 GW cell production from 2H FY27; 6 GW by June-July 2027
guidance.quote: we'll be 6 gigawatt by somewhere around mid of -- around July -- yes, June-July 2027
